```objective-c AEAssessmentApplication *calculator = [[AEAssessmentApplication alloc] initWithBundleIdentifier:calculatorBundleID]; switch ( [self.calculatorOptions selectedSegment] ) { case 0: // Not allowed. [self log:@"Calculator will not be allowed when locked"]; break; case 1: // Allowed, no network. [self log:@"Calculator will be allowed when locked, with no network access."]; [config setConfiguration:noNetworkConfig forApplication:calculator]; break; case 2: // Allowed, with network.
